item.description: As tributes poured in following the shocking deaths of filmmaker Rob Reiner and his wife, one voice stood out for very different reasons. item.title: Ukraine blows up Russian submarine using underwater drone "for the first time in history"
item.description: Ukraine said it used underwater drones to strike and disable a Russian missile-carrying submarine at a Black Sea naval base, calling the strike a historic first in naval warfare, a claim Russia rejected, saying the attack caused no damage. Ukraine's Security Service said the strike took place at the port of Novorossiysk, where Russia has relocated much of its Black Sea Fleet to reduce its exposure to Ukrainian attacks. item.title: Trump sues BBC for defamation over edited January 6 speech (seeks up to $10 billion)
item.description: Trump has filed a defamation lawsuit against the BBC, accusing the British broadcaster of misleadingly editing footage of a January 6, 2021 speech to suggest he incited violence at the United States Capitol. The lawsuit, filed on Monday in federal court in Miami, seeks $5 billion in damages on two counts, totaling up to $10 billion.
